name: den-marketplace
description: Development toolchain for the den plugin marketplace: TypeScript, Biome, the git hook path, and the test entry point. Nothing here is installed for plugin users; each plugin carries its own runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test "tests/*.test.mts" && npm --prefix plugins/context-budget test && npm --prefix plugins/den test && npm --prefix plugins/model-prompts test
